instagram_caption:
She shouted at her little brother tonight, and the voice that came out was not hers. It was her father's.

She spent her whole childhood promising she would never make anyone feel like that.

Jesus tells her the truth she cannot see: her father never once stood in a doorway afraid of what he had become. She is standing there now. That is the whole difference.

You were not adopted into fear. You were adopted into a family where you can begin again, tonight, before he falls asleep.

Is there a voice you are trying not to repeat? 🙏
youtube_title: Jesus... I Heard My Father's Voice Come Out Of My Mouth | Jesus Replies
youtube_description:
She shouted at her younger brother tonight, and what came out was not her voice. It was her father's. She watched her brother go quiet and small, exactly the way she used to.

Jesus shows her what she cannot see from inside the fear. Her father never once stood in a doorway afraid of what he had become. She is standing there now, and that is the whole difference. Being sorry is not what breaks something that old. Going back into the room is.

"The Spirit you received does not make you slaves, so that you live in fear again; rather, the Spirit you received brought about your adoption to sonship. And by him we cry, 'Abba, Father.'" - Romans 8:15 (NIV)

If there is a voice you are trying not to repeat, you are allowed to begin again tonight.
